title: In Tanzania, the sea is moving inland – and taking livelihoods with it
content:
Along the coast of Tanzania, in East Africa, the Indian Ocean is pushing saltwater ever farther inland, shrinking coconut harvests, driving fish away and leaving some residents wondering how much longer they can stay. Read Full Story on UN News

title: As freshwater reserves shrink, countries must prepare for a new water reality
content:
The world is entering a period in which abnormal water supplies are becoming the norm, with river flows, groundwater and glaciers all showing signs of sustained disruption, the UN weather agency warned on Thursday.  Read Full Story on UN News
